rationale.hitl-workflow: Defines human checkpoints, bounded delegation, takeover, ownership, and review duties.
rationale.rules-based-checks: Centers tests, CI/CD, linting, static analysis, sandboxes, and deterministic gates.
rationale.ai-review: Uses agents and multiple models to critique code, tests, and fixes.
rationale.risk-routing: Operationalizes risk-proportional review and automated deployment fast lanes.
rationale.oversight-explanation: Requires diffs, summaries, logs, explanations, and decision-supporting context.
rationale.agent-scope-drift: Documents instruction drift, wrong workspaces, deletions, and sandboxed boundaries.
rationale.org-governance: Specifies organization-wide standards, ownership, guardrails, roles, and accountability.
rationale.provenance-auditability: Makes Git history, commits, diffs, and backups persistent review evidence.
rationale.quality-debt: Documents AI-created coupling, bloat, unreadable code, and technical debt.
rationale.automation-bias: Experienced authors over-trust agents, miss warnings, and accept misleading success.
rationale.oversight-scaling-inversion: AI multiplies code volume while human reading, review, and coordination lag.
rationale.counterpoint: Opposes brain-off automation-maximalism and blanket rejection of production vibe coding.
